summary: Cairo is the vibrant heart of Egypt, home to the iconic Great Pyramids of Giza, the Egyptian Museum, and bustling Islamic bazaars that pulse with ancient history and modern energy. This sprawling metropolis offers world-class archaeological wonders, authentic street food, and captivating urban photography opportunities against the backdrop of the Nile River. From Pharaonic temples to contemporary neighborhoods, Cairo seamlessly blends millennia of civilizations into an unforgettable destination.

restaurants.name: Koshary Abou Tarek
restaurants.description: A legendary street food institution serving Egypt's national comfort dish of rice, lentils, pasta, and tomato sauce. This humble hole-in-the-wall has been perfecting koshary since 1957 and remains consistently packed with locals.
restaurants.mustTry: Classic Koshary with extra crispy fried onions

restaurants.name: Abu El Sid
restaurants.description: An upscale Egyptian restaurant showcasing traditional cuisine in an elegant setting with period artwork and antiques. Menu features authentic recipes passed down through generations with dishes like koshari, moussaka, and fresh grilled fish.

restaurants.name: Nile Sunset Restaurant
restaurants.description: A romantic floating restaurant on the Nile offering Mediterranean and Egyptian cuisine with panoramic river views. Perfect for dinner while watching felucca sailboats drift by at dusk.
restaurants.mustTry: Grilled sea bass with herbs and fresh vegetables

restaurants.name: Zooba
restaurants.description: A modern casual chain elevating Egyptian street food with quality ingredients and contemporary presentation. Serves authentic ful medames, falafel, ta'ameya, and fresh juices in a trendy atmosphere.
restaurants.mustTry: Ful Medames with warm pita bread

restaurants.name: Sequoia
restaurants.description: An exclusive fine dining restaurant set on a private island with stunning Nile views, serving innovative Mediterranean and Egyptian fusion cuisine. Impeccable service and curated wine selections complement the refined dishes.
restaurants.mustTry: Pan-seared duck breast with orange glaze and local herbs

restaurants.name: Khan el-Khalili Tea House
restaurants.description: A historic tea house in the heart of Khan el-Khalili bazaar serving traditional Egyptian mint tea and coffee with shisha. Experience authentic local culture while watching street life unfold from wooden balconies.
restaurants.mustTry: Mint tea with fresh herbs and Egyptian hibiscus (karkade)

restaurants.name: Nefertiti Restaurant
restaurants.description: A well-established restaurant overlooking the Nile serving Egyptian and Mediterranean dishes with emphasis on fresh seafood and grilled meats. Known for attentive service and consistent quality.
restaurants.mustTry: Mixed grill platter for two with fresh lemon and herbs

restaurants.name: Seoudi
restaurants.description: A fast-casual Egyptian restaurant chain popular for quick authentic meals including shawarma, falafel, and grilled chicken sandwiches. Perfect for budget-conscious travelers wanting genuine local food.
restaurants.mustTry: Chicken shawarma sandwich with tahini sauce

restaurants.name: Citadel View Restaurant
restaurants.description: Located near the Citadel, this restaurant offers panoramic views of Cairo's skyline and serves Egyptian, Lebanese, and Mediterranean cuisine. Ideal for sunset dining with photography opportunities.
restaurants.mustTry: Lamb kofta with homemade pita and fresh salads

restaurants.name: Al-Fishawi Café
restaurants.description: The oldest café in Cairo established in 1773, serving traditional Egyptian coffee, tea, and light snacks in an atmospheric setting filled with local clientele and heritage. A must-visit for cultural immersion.

restaurants.name: Osmanturk
restaurants.description: A Turkish restaurant in Zamalek offering grilled meats, kebabs, and Mediterranean dishes with an extensive selection of appetizers. Lively atmosphere with both indoor and outdoor seating.
restaurants.mustTry: Adana kebab with sumac onions and fresh herbs

restaurants.name: The Smokery
restaurants.description: An upscale grill restaurant serving premium cuts of meat and fresh seafood with sophisticated sides and extensive wine selection. Contemporary design with attentive service makes it ideal for special occasions.
restaurants.mustTry: Prime ribeye steak with truffle cream and seasonal vegetables

activities.name: Great Pyramids of Giza Tour
activities.description: Explore the iconic pyramid complex including the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the Pyramid of Khafre, and the enigmatic Sphinx. This UNESCO World Heritage Site represents the pinnacle of ancient Egyptian engineering and remains one of the world's most recognizable monuments.

activities.name: Egyptian Museum Visit
activities.description: View the world's largest collection of ancient Egyptian artifacts including the treasures of Tutankhamun, mummies, and countless statues and papyri. This museum provides essential context for understanding Egypt's 3,000-year history.

activities.name: Khan el-Khalili Bazaar Exploration
activities.description: Wander through Cairo's most famous medieval bazaar filled with spice shops, textile vendors, jewelry stalls, and artisan crafts. The labyrinthine alleys offer sensory experiences and authentic local shopping without tourist markup.

activities.name: Nile River Felucca Sailing
activities.description: Experience traditional sailing on a felucca boat, the same type used for centuries on the Nile. Watch the sunset or sunrise while navigating the river that has sustained Egyptian civilization.

activities.name: Islamic Cairo Walking Tour
activities.description: Explore historic Islamic monuments including the Al-Azhar Mosque, Khan el-Khalili, medieval gates, and narrow lanes filled with traditional architecture. This UNESCO-listed area showcases Cairo's Islamic heritage spanning centuries.

activities.name: Citadel of Saladin Visit
activities.description: Tour the impressive fortress perched above Cairo with museums, mosques, and panoramic city views from its ramparts. Built by Saladin in the 12th century, it's one of the most intact medieval fortifications in the world.

activities.name: Cairo Street Food Tour
activities.description: Join a guided tour through local neighborhoods sampling authentic street food including ful, ta'ameya, koshari, and fresh juices. Learn about Egyptian food culture and dining customs from knowledgeable local guides.

activities.name: Coptic Cairo Exploration
activities.description: Visit the historic Coptic Christian quarter with ancient churches including the Hanging Church, Ben Ezra Synagogue, and museums dedicated to religious artifacts. This area preserves centuries of Christian and Jewish heritage in Egypt.

activities.name: Memphis and Saqqara Day Trip
activities.description: Travel south to ancient Memphis, Egypt's first capital, and explore the pyramid complexes of Saqqara including the famous Step Pyramid of Djoser. These sites offer fewer crowds and excellent examples of pyramid evolution.

activities.name: Cairo Opera House Performance
activities.description: Attend a ballet, opera, or concert at the modern Cairo Opera House featuring world-class performances and Egyptian artists. The stunning architecture and cultural programming provide a refined evening experience.

activities.name: Cairo Contemporary Art Walk
activities.description: Explore Cairo's growing contemporary art scene with galleries in Zamalek and Downtown featuring local and international artists. Visit street art in neighborhoods like Maadi and Heliopolis for urban art documentation.

activities.name: Nile Sunset Dinner Cruise
activities.description: Board an evening dinner cruise with live entertainment, buffet dining, and views of illuminated Cairo landmarks from the water. Includes traditional music and dancing while navigating the river.

spots.name: Great Pyramids of Giza Complex
spots.description: The iconic pyramids provide dramatic compositions with varied lighting throughout the day, especially beautiful during golden hour when distant city lights begin to glow.

spots.name: Khan el-Khalili Bazaar
spots.description: Narrow alleyways filled with colorful textiles, spices, and local characters create vibrant street photography opportunities with natural light filtering through the dense stalls.

spots.name: Nile River Banks at Sunset
spots.description: The river creates stunning reflections of Cairo's skyline, felucca boats, and the golden sky, with bridges and mosques framing compositions throughout the waterfront.

spots.name: Citadel of Saladin Ramparts
spots.description: Elevated vantage points offer panoramic views of Islamic Cairo, modern city sprawl, and distant desert landscapes with the Citadel's architectural elements in the foreground.
spots.bestTime: Morning for clear visibility or sunset for dramatic lighting

spots.name: Islamic Cairo Streets
spots.description: Historic alleyways with medieval architecture, arched passages, traditional doors, and atmospheric shadows create compelling compositions for architectural and street photography.
spots.bestTime: Early morning when light creates strong geometric shadows

spots.name: Cairo Traffic and Street Scenes
spots.description: Chaotic urban energy captured through busy intersections, colorful vehicles, pedestrians, and vendor stands showcase authentic Cairo street life with dynamic composition potential.
spots.bestTime: Morning or afternoon for varied street activity

spots.name: Sphinx and Pyramid Complex (Giza Plateau)
spots.description: The enigmatic Sphinx framed by pyramids in the background offers iconic compositions, particularly stunning during sunrise when desert light creates warm, dimensional photographs.
spots.bestTime: Sunrise for exclusive light and minimal crowds

spots.name: Al-Azhar Mosque Interior
spots.description: Ornate Islamic architecture with intricate geometric patterns, soaring columns, and natural light streaming through high windows creates intimate cultural photography opportunities.
spots.bestTime: Mid-morning when interior light is balanced

spots.name: Cairo Night Skyline from Elevated Viewpoints
spots.description: Illuminated mosques, minarets, and modern buildings create a glittering cityscape from rooftop locations and elevated areas with tripod-friendly compositions for night photography.
spots.bestTime: 30 minutes after sunset for twilight color balance

spots.name: Felucca Boats on the Nile
spots.description: Traditional white-sailed boats create picturesque compositions against the river, especially beautiful when multiple boats are visible sailing during golden hour with the city backdrop.
spots.bestTime: Late afternoon when boats are actively sailing

sunriseSpots: Cairo Citadel of Saladin (ramparts for city sunrise)
Nile River East Bank near Helwan
lensRecommendations: Wide-angle (16-35mm) for pyramid complexes and cityscape panoramas
Standard (50mm) for street photography in bazaars and alleys with natural perspective
Telephoto (70-200mm) for compressed backgrounds and isolated architectural details
Macro (90-105mm) for detailed craft and textile documentation in Khan el-Khalili
photography.goldenHourNotes: Cairo's golden hour is exceptional due to dust particles in the air creating luminous atmospheric conditions. The hour before sunset transforms the pyramids and Nile into warm, glowing subjects. Early morning light over the Giza plateau creates dramatic long shadows and cooler tones ideal for architecture. Plan shoots 30 minutes before official sunset time to capture the most dramatic light.

weather.seasonality: Cairo experiences extreme heat from May through September, with temperatures exceeding 30°C regularly. The ideal visiting season is November through March when temperatures are mild (13-25°C) and humidity is lower, making sightseeing comfortable.
weather.summary: Cairo has a hot desert climate with virtually no rainfall year-round. Winter months (November-March) offer pleasant temperatures perfect for exploring outdoor sites, while summer heat makes outdoor activities challenging but enables excellent night photography and evening activities.

hotels.name: Nile Ibis Cairo
hotels.description: A reliable budget hotel in central Downtown with basic but clean rooms, convenient access to museums and bazaars, and friendly staff eager to help with travel planning.

hotels.name: Mena House Hotel
hotels.description: A historic mid-range property with direct views of the Pyramids of Giza from many rooms, excellent restaurant, and convenient location for accessing the pyramid complex and nearby archaeological sites.

hotels.name: Nile Ritz-Carlton Cairo
hotels.description: An elegant luxury hotel on the Nile with impeccable service, fine dining restaurants, spa facilities, and spacious rooms offering panoramic river views of the Cairo skyline.
